questions.question: What is the main topic of the target passage?
questions.answer: It explains the First Truth, which is about Allah opening and shaping many different forms, and how this shows His oneness.

questions.question: What does the phrase “Truth of Opening” mean in this passage?
questions.answer: It means Allah brings out many different living forms from simple beginnings.

questions.question: From what kind of beginning does the passage say many different forms come?
questions.answer: They come from a single simple substance.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the number of forms that are brought out?
questions.answer: They are beyond counting and very diverse.

questions.question: Does the passage present this opening of forms as happening slowly one by one or together by one act?
questions.answer: It presents it as happening together by one act.

questions.question: Which Divine Name is especially connected to this truth?
questions.answer: The Name of Opener.

questions.question: What example from the universe is given first to help us understand this opening?
questions.answer: The example of flowers appearing in the garden of the universe.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah gives to each being when He opens its form?
questions.answer: He gives each one an ordered shape and its own distinct identity.

questions.question: What example from the earth is given after the example of flowers?
questions.answer: The many kinds of living creatures on the earth.

questions.question: About how many species of living things does the passage mention?
questions.answer: It mentions four hundred thousand species.

questions.question: How are the forms of those living species described?
questions.answer: They are balanced, beautiful, and different from one another.

questions.question: What human example is used from the Qur’an to show Allah’s forming power?
questions.answer: Human beings being formed in their mothers’ wombs.

questions.question: In that example, what shows Allah’s careful control over creation?
questions.answer: People are formed step by step with order and as Allah wills.

questions.question: According to the passage, what do botany and biology support?
questions.answer: They support that the unfolding of forms is so wide and skillful that only Allah can do it.

questions.question: Why can no weak or limited being do this work, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Because it needs complete wisdom, careful attention, full knowledge, and unlimited power.

questions.question: What kind of Being alone can carry out such an all-reaching work?
questions.answer: The One unique Being Who manages the whole universe.

questions.question: How are human and animal forms across the earth said to be made?
questions.answer: They are made by the same power, with the same wisdom and artistry.

questions.question: Why is the unfolding of forms called a strong proof of Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: Because a work that covers and controls everything leaves no room for partners.

questions.question: What problem does the passage say is absent in Allah’s forming of beings?
questions.answer: There is no mix-up, no error, and no mistake.

questions.question: What big idea should a student learn from this passage?
questions.answer: The order, beauty, and variety in living things show that one all-powerful Allah creates them all.

questions.question: What truth is being explained in this passage?
questions.answer: The passage explains the Truth of Opening.

questions.question: What action does “opening” refer to here?
questions.answer: It refers to Allah bringing out and shaping living forms.

questions.question: Does the passage connect this action to one source or many sources?
questions.answer: It connects it to one source, Allah alone.

questions.question: What is surprising about how these forms appear?
questions.answer: Many different forms appear at the same time, in many places, through one command and power.

questions.question: What picture from nature helps explain this idea first?
questions.answer: The picture of flowers appearing in a garden.

questions.question: In that example, what does each flower-like being receive?
questions.answer: Each one receives its own orderly shape and special identity.

questions.question: How does the passage compare the earth to a garden?
questions.answer: It says the earth is like a garden filled with many kinds of living creatures.

questions.question: What number is given for the species of animate beings?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand species.

questions.question: What three qualities are used for the forms of these species?
questions.answer: They are balanced, decorated, and distinct.

questions.question: Which place inside the human body’s beginning is mentioned as a sign of Allah’s power?
questions.answer: The mother’s womb.

questions.question: What do the Qur’anic verses in the passage teach about forming human beings?
questions.answer: They teach that Allah shapes people as He wills and nothing is hidden from Him.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is the shaping of forms such a great sign?
questions.answer: Because it is one of the clearest signs of Allah’s power and oneness.

questions.question: Which fields of study are named as witnesses to this truth?
questions.answer: Botany and biology.

questions.question: What do those fields show about the unfolding of forms?
questions.answer: They show amazing skill, wide reach, and deep order in living things.

questions.question: What qualities are needed to carry out this work of giving forms?
questions.answer: Wisdom, careful attention, comprehensiveness, and infinite power.

questions.question: Why does infinite power matter in this discussion?
questions.answer: Because forming all kinds of beings everywhere and always is too great for limited power.

questions.question: What does the passage say about Allah’s making of people and animals all over the earth?
questions.answer: It says He makes them all with one power, one wisdom, and one artistry.

questions.question: How does comprehending all things point to unity?
questions.answer: If one Being fully covers all things, then others cannot share in that work.

questions.question: What false idea is pushed away by this truth?
questions.answer: The idea that Allah could have partners in creation.

questions.question: If a student sees many different creatures made with order and beauty, what conclusion does this passage guide the student to?
questions.answer: The student should understand that one unique Creator made them all.

questions.question: What is the first truth named in the passage?
questions.answer: It is the Truth of Opening.

questions.question: What does the passage say comes from one simple source?
questions.answer: Countless different and separate forms come from it.

questions.question: How widely does this opening of forms happen?
questions.answer: It happens everywhere.

questions.question: How quickly does the passage describe this act?
questions.answer: It describes it as happening in a single instant.

questions.question: By whose manifestation does this opening happen?
questions.answer: It happens through the manifestation of Allah’s Name of Opener.

questions.question: What example from the “garden of the cosmos” is used?
questions.answer: Many beings are compared to flowers in that great garden.

questions.question: What two things are given to each being in that example?
questions.answer: An orderly form and a separate identity.

questions.question: What larger example on earth is given after that?
questions.answer: The many species of living things spread across the earth.

questions.question: How does the passage describe Allah’s work with these species compared with the first example?
questions.answer: It says this is even more wondrous.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the forms of living species?
questions.answer: Each species is given a well-shaped, decorated, and unique form.

questions.question: What lesson comes from the Qur’anic verses about babies in the womb?
questions.answer: Allah creates and shapes human beings step by step in hidden places.

questions.question: What do those verses also say about Allah’s knowledge?
questions.answer: Nothing in the heavens or the earth is hidden from Him.

questions.question: Why are the opening and shaping of forms called a strong proof?
questions.answer: Because they show power and knowledge that only Allah can have.

questions.question: How do science studies mentioned in the passage support this idea?
questions.answer: They show that plants and living things have such detailed design that only one all-powerful Creator could form them.

questions.question: What kind of power would be too weak for this task?
questions.answer: Any limited or partial power would be too weak.

questions.question: What must be present at all times for this work to happen, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Wisdom, attention, and complete reach must always be present.

questions.question: Who alone has the power to manage such a complete work?
questions.answer: The unique One Who runs the whole universe.

questions.question: How are people and animals across the earth formed in the passage?
questions.answer: They are formed with balance and order, without confusion or mistakes.

questions.question: Why does this truth leave no room for shirk?
questions.answer: Because one all-encompassing act of creation cannot be divided among partners.

questions.question: What is one simple summary sentence for this passage?
questions.answer: The many beautiful forms in creation show that Allah is One.

questions.question: Which truth does the traveler see in this part of the passage?
questions.answer: He sees the First Truth, the Truth of Opening.

questions.question: What does Allah open up from a simple starting point?
questions.answer: He opens up many different forms.

questions.question: Are these forms described as alike or varied?
questions.answer: They are described as varied.

questions.question: What does the passage say about when and where this opening happens?
questions.answer: It happens together, all around, by one deed.

questions.question: What Divine Name is shown through this action?
questions.answer: The Name of Opener.

questions.question: What example from a garden is used to explain the idea?
questions.answer: The appearance of many flower-like beings in the garden of the universe.

questions.question: What special gift does each created thing receive besides existence?
questions.answer: It receives a proper shape and a separate identity.

questions.question: What is the “garden of the earth” filled with in the passage?
questions.answer: It is filled with many species of living things.

questions.question: How many species are mentioned?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand.

questions.question: In what way are these living forms made?
questions.answer: They are made in a balanced, beautiful, and unique way.

questions.question: What hidden place is mentioned to show Allah’s shaping of human beings?
questions.answer: The wombs of mothers.

questions.question: What do the verses teach about Allah’s control over this process?
questions.answer: He forms each person exactly as He wills.

questions.question: What do the verses teach about Allah’s knowledge?
questions.answer: He knows everything, and nothing is concealed from Him.

questions.question: Which school subjects are mentioned as giving support to this truth?
questions.answer: Botany and biology.

questions.question: According to the passage, why can only Allah do this work?
questions.answer: Because the work is universal, detailed, wise, and needs unlimited power.

questions.question: What three mental qualities are needed for such forming, according to the passage?
questions.answer: Wisdom, careful attention, and comprehensiveness.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect this work to the One Who rules the whole cosmos?
questions.answer: Because only the One managing everything can shape everything in such a complete way.

questions.question: What is missing from Allah’s creation of forms everywhere on earth?
questions.answer: Mistakes, disorder, and confusion are missing.

questions.question: How does the passage connect all-embracing creation with tawhid?
questions.answer: It says that if one act includes all things, then it shows oneness and rejects partners.

questions.question: What should this truth do to a believer’s heart?
questions.answer: It should strengthen faith in Allah’s unity and power.

questions.question: What title is given to the truth explained here?
questions.answer: The Truth of Opening.

questions.question: In this passage, what is being “opened”?
questions.answer: The forms and shapes of living beings are being opened and brought forth.

questions.question: What is special about the source these many forms come from?
questions.answer: The source is single and simple, yet many different forms come from it.

questions.question: How many forms does the passage suggest are produced?
questions.answer: Very many, beyond easy counting.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about how this happens?
questions.answer: It happens together by one action of Allah.

questions.question: What Name of Allah is linked to this action?
questions.answer: The Name of Opener.

questions.question: What example from the larger universe is mentioned first?
questions.answer: The bringing forth of many beings like flowers.

questions.question: What does each of those beings receive?
questions.answer: Each receives order in its shape and its own distinct identity.

questions.question: What example from the earth shows this truth more clearly?
questions.answer: The many kinds of animate creatures on earth.

questions.question: How are those creatures’ forms described?
questions.answer: Their forms are measured, ornamented, and different from one another.

questions.question: What human life example from the Qur’an supports this truth?
questions.answer: Human beings are shaped in their mothers’ wombs.

questions.question: What does that example teach about Allah’s creating?
questions.answer: He creates in stages and forms each person exactly as He chooses.

questions.question: What does the passage say is one of the clearest miracles of Divine power?
questions.answer: The bringing out of forms.

questions.question: Which branches of knowledge are said to witness this truth?
questions.answer: The study of plants and the study of living things.

questions.question: What do they show about the making of forms?
questions.answer: They show amazing skill and a reach so broad that only Allah can do it.

questions.question: What kind of power is required for this deed?
questions.answer: A power that is unlimited and present in all things.

questions.question: Why is wisdom important in this passage’s argument?
questions.answer: Because these forms are not random; they are made with purpose and care.

questions.question: What does the passage say about mistakes in this process?
questions.answer: There are no mistakes, no confusion, and no disorder.

questions.question: Why does this truth count as evidence for Allah’s unity?
questions.answer: Because one complete act covering all creation can belong only to one Creator.

questions.question: What is the best faith lesson from this passage for a 5th-grade student?
questions.answer: When we see the careful design of living things, we should remember Allah alone made them.

questions.question: What is the name of the first truth in the marked passage?
questions.answer: It is the Truth of Opening.

questions.question: What does this truth focus on in creation?
questions.answer: It focuses on Allah giving shape and form to countless living things.

questions.question: What kind of substance does the passage say these many forms come from?
questions.answer: They come from a single simple substance.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the forms themselves?
questions.answer: They are many, different, and separate.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the speed and unity of this act?
questions.answer: It says it happens at once through a single deed.

questions.question: Which Name of Allah appears through this work?
questions.answer: The Name of Opener.

questions.question: What example is given from the “cosmos” to picture this act?
questions.answer: The example of flowers appearing in a great garden.

questions.question: What does Allah give each being in that example?
questions.answer: He gives each being a well-arranged form and a unique identity.

questions.question: What earthly example is then mentioned?
questions.answer: The many species of animate beings on earth.

questions.question: How many species are named?
questions.answer: Four hundred thousand species.

questions.question: What do their forms show about their Maker?
questions.answer: They show balance, beauty, and distinction in His creation.

questions.question: Which human beginning is used as evidence in the Qur’anic verses?
questions.answer: A person’s formation in the womb.

questions.question: What do those verses teach about Allah’s knowledge and power?
questions.answer: They teach that He knows all things and shapes people however He wills.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is the shaping of forms so important?
questions.answer: Because it is a very strong sign of Allah’s power and unity.

questions.question: What two sciences are mentioned as testifying to this truth?
questions.answer: Botany and biology.

questions.question: What is their testimony, in simple words?
questions.answer: They show that the forms of living things are too skillful and far-reaching to come from anyone but Allah.

questions.question: What qualities must the maker have to do this deed?
questions.answer: The maker must have complete wisdom, full awareness, and infinite power.

questions.question: Why can this power belong only to the One Who runs the universe?
questions.answer: Because the work includes all living things across creation.

questions.question: How does the passage describe the creation of humans and animals across the earth?
questions.answer: It says they are formed with the same power, wisdom, and artistry, without error.

questions.question: What final conclusion does the passage want the reader to reach?
questions.answer: The opening and shaping of all forms proves that Allah is One and has no partner.
